name: Definium Therapeutics, Inc.
base_source: TTM through Q2 2026 from EDGAR 10-Q YTD (OCF -$167.951M = FY25 -$131.560M - H1'25 -$59.018M + H1'26 -$95.409M; minus SBC TTM $28.188M from AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense — a tag the engine misses — and capex ~$0 = -$196.139M / 109.743M H1'26 diluted shares); engine normalized 3-yr median was -$1.47 and latest FY -$1.47 (-$1.70 SBC-corrected) — all bases negative, Tier F under every base — see analysis.md
moat_justification: Weak-to-moderate and approval-contingent: most advanced LSD program (three positive Phase 3 trials across GAD and MDD, Breakthrough Therapy designation in both, pre-NDA meeting set for late 2026) plus ODT formulation/dosing IP and a ~6h supervised-session model, but the active molecule is a long-known off-patent Schedule I compound competitors can route around (COMPASS COMP360, Lilly/AtaiBeckley, AbbVie/Gilgamesh), no pricing power or payer coverage is proven, functional unblinding is a live criticism, DEA/state rescheduling sits between approval and revenue, and the pipeline is single-asset (DT402 only Phase 2a).
one_liner: Pre-revenue single-asset psychedelic biotech, moat 4/10 contingent on approval — owner's earnings are negative in all 6 years of history (-$1.79/share TTM) despite three positive Phase 3 DT120 trials in GAD/MDD and ~$1.05B net cash, so it cannot clear the 15% hurdle at any price on an OE DCF; the $35.20 price is an FDA-approval option, not an earnings stream.
